I can't see the meal after eating, so the leftover figure is an assumption. I estimated the served items from the photo and assumed the person eats most of the meal.

Served items:
- Toast, 2 slices: about 160 kcal, 5 g protein, 30 g carbs, 2 g fat.
- Orange juice, about 200 ml: about 90 kcal, 1.5 g protein, 21 g carbs, 0.4 g fat.
- Strawberry yogurt, 170 g: about 150 kcal, 6 g protein, 25 g carbs, 3 g fat.
- Peanut butter, 2 small portions of about 15 g each: about 180 kcal, 7 g protein, 5 g carbs, 15 g fat.

Together the served meal is about 580 kcal, 19.5 g protein, 81 g carbs and 20.4 g fat.

I assumed about 40 kcal is left over, mostly some of the toast or yogurt. That leaves about 540 kcal eaten, with roughly 18 g protein, 75 g carbs and 19 g fat.
